verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question for an operating system platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or any deprecation policy. The pack covers only consumer features (Continuity, Siri AI, Spotlight, Shortcuts), and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
